topic:
Add a 'markdown' formatter to the text processing pipeline. The app already has 'uppercase' and 'reverse' formatters in formatters/. Study the existing formatters to understand the EXACT pattern (how they export, what they return, how they are registered). Then: (1) create formatters/markdown.js that wraps text in markdown bold (**text**) and converts newlines to
, (2) register it in pipeline.js, (3) update the process function in pipeline.js to support chaining multiple formatters. Run "node test/pipeline.test.js". When tests pass, call finish.
